Exercise supported outer mappings with standard MappingProxyType and UserDict containing ordinary nested dict/list documents. Check constructor/input/returned-value independence, same Outcome identity, first-failure short circuit and deduplicated remember history. Derive all expectations from the specification.

exp-v1-recovery-r2-python-generation-051.specification_review: Exercise read-only MappingProxyType caches on no-match, cached hit, and new download; also read-only available. Returned cache must be detached mutable dict, cache hit avoids available lookup, missing URL leaves inputs unchanged. Preserve parser, URL resolution, filename collisions and input validation tests without inventing broader URL guarantees.

exp-v1-recovery-r2-go-generation-0740.specification_review: Cover valid architecture-sized maximum int capacity using int(^uint(0)>>1), only a few reservations. At full capacity another positive-seat addition must reject atomically; at max-1, adding one succeeds and the next fails. Check cancellation, unchanged ID allocation on failure, bounded ordered snapshots and mutation isolation. Avoid huge collections/private counter injection.

exp-v1-recovery-r2-go-generation-0761.specification_review: Cover valid maximum int logical Capacity using int(^uint(0)>>1) with MaxPayloadBytes one and only a few actual packets. Construction, enqueue, selective drain/count and non-nil empties must work. Include bounded concurrent overlapping Enqueue/Drain/Count with synchronized successful-enqueue accounting and exact conservation after join. No sleeps or assumed cross-goroutine order, and no equality of separate counts during mutation. Retain input/output payload ownership and invalid-before-full precedence.

exp-v1-recovery-r2-javascript-generation.specification_review: Do not require rejection of array-valued changes when no contract rule forbids them, or mandatory retention of optional extra fields. Test directly readable non-enumerable and inherited required key/code/owner/openedOn fields through constructor/add/edit, unchanged branches and search identities. Missing-key edit must return identical registry even with irrelevant invalid changes. Supported own hidden patch fields must work; do not invent inherited-patch or universal deep-copy guarantees.

Only required part fields id/label/hours/pinned are mandatory on replacement; do not assert arbitrary metadata/note retention or descriptor preservation. Build a valid external null-prototype byId with non-enumerable engine and enumerable wing, order [engine,wing]; pin/unpin wing preserves engine by identity and preserves order identity. Cover hidden directly readable required fields, __proto__ data IDs, selective sharing, no-op identity and atomic invalid replacement.

Remove the placeholder expectation that unsupported active patch throws; only supported fields change, extras including id are ignored. Cover a non-enumerable seat update, ID retention, undefined/absent fields, invalid multi-field atomicity, collisions, queries and deletion. Retain constructor malformed/duplicate performance validation with bounded fixtures.
